description: Source file implementing GestureConverter class for handling gesture input events, converting them into motion events, managing gesture states like move, scroll, pinch, swipe, and button changes within Android input system.

classes.name: GestureConverter
classes.description: Class responsible for converting gesture input events into Android motion events, managing gesture states, and handling different gesture types such as move, scroll, pinch, swipe, and button changes.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current state of the GestureConverter, including orientation, axis info, button state, down time, and current classification.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the gesture state based on the current classification, ending gestures like scroll, swipe, or pinch, and releasing all buttons if pressed.

methods.name: populateMotionRanges
methods.description: Populates the InputDeviceInfo with motion ranges for pressure, axes, and gesture-specific offsets based on current pointer controller bounds.

methods.name: handleGesture
methods.description: Dispatches gesture handling based on gesture type, calling specific handlers for move, button change, scroll, fling, swipe, and pinch gestures.

methods.name: handleMove
methods.description: Handles move gestures by updating pointer position, creating move motion events with relative movement and pressure.

methods.name: handleButtonsChange
methods.description: Handles button press/release gestures, updating button states, generating corresponding button press/release motion events.

methods.name: releaseAllButtons
methods.description: Releases all pressed buttons, generating button release motion events.

methods.name: handleScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll gestures by updating pointer position and generating move events with scroll offsets.

methods.name: handleFling
methods.description: Handles fling gestures, particularly ending scroll gestures or indicating contact initiation with the touchpad.

methods.name: endScroll
methods.description: Ends a scroll gesture by generating an up event and resetting gesture classification.

methods.name: handleMultiFingerSwipe
methods.description: Handles multi-finger swipe gestures, simulating multiple pointers and generating corresponding move events.

methods.name: handleMultiFingerSwipeLift
methods.description: Handles lifting fingers in multi-finger swipe gestures, generating pointer up and up events.

methods.name: handlePinch
methods.description: Handles pinch gestures, updating finger separation and scale factor, generating move events during pinch, and handling start/end of pinch.

methods.name: endPinch
methods.description: Ends a pinch gesture by releasing pointer down and up events.

methods.name: makeMotionArgs
methods.description: Constructs a NotifyMotionArgs object representing a motion event with specified parameters.
